claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 280 miles E of Sandy Hook (23d 2 p. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Iowa (Br.), Craig, Glasgow 10th, and Moville 11th inst.,
p. m., with mdse. and 250 pass. to F. Macdonald & Co. Aug. 10, 30
miles from Greenock, passed steamship Hibernia, bound in; 15th, lat.
53 50, long. 28 40, steamship United Kingdom, hence for Glasgow;
23d, 2 p. m., 280 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Java, bound E;
same day, 6 p. m., 250 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Tripoli,
bound E; off Nantucket, passed ship American Union, from Havre
for New-York.
